chapter: Joe Liggins and back to Kid Ory
title: Ram Hall's drumming and favorite drummers
summary: Ram was adequate but rushed the time; Joe's favorite drummers were Big Sid and Nick Fatool.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Ram was pretty good. Yeah, Ram was a good drummer. I wouldn't say he was one of my favorites, but he was adequate. Ram had a tendency to kind of speed up his time, which... Zutty was just the opposite, and Alton Redd; they would slow you down. Their foot would give it a ...(? )...
Well, just for listening, Big Sid. And Nick Fatool, one of your real fine drummers. I think you're going to find a much...

I only ask that... We're getting really out of context. I only ask that because you said "he wasn't one of my favorites," and I just thought who was your favorite. Well, those two drummers are fantastic.
Big Sid was number one to my idea, really.
